picks.editorial_note: A $38M ARPA-H contract to build AI 'digital twins' of critically ill patients is the largest research award in UVM's history, signaling major federal investment in AI-driven personalized critical care.

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech and Amazon's new Science Hub formalizes a decade of collaboration into a dedicated academic-industry research program, the kind of durable corporate-university partnership that shapes AI research agendas for years.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's open-source Tessera model outperforming existing crop-mapping methods with far less compute in Senegal shows AI delivering tangible benefit to smallholder farmers in the developing world.
picks.title: AI tool for mapping smallholder crops proves itself in Senegal

picks.editorial_note: A $4.25M DARPA grant to a WashU-led team fusing AI with physics-based simulation for fuel injector design shows significant defense-sector investment in AI-accelerated engineering.
picks.title: WashU-led team wins $4M DARPA grant to improve fuel injector design

picks.editorial_note: A MacArthur Fellowship recognizing AI-driven agricultural science that fuses satellite data, process models, and supercomputing is a prestigious national validation of AI's role in food security research.
picks.title: U. of I. researcher and alumnus both named 2026 MacArthur Fellows

picks.editorial_note: Clemson's push to understand and safeguard against AI-generated harmful content targeting young people addresses an urgent child-safety gap in generative AI policy and oversight.

picks.editorial_note: UW-Madison's individualized AI-driven 'brain roadmaps' linking cellular and genetic changes to Alzheimer's progression represent a meaningful advance toward precision neurodegeneration medicine.

picks.editorial_note: Brown engineers' brain-inspired imaging system that sees through fog by mimicking retinal response is a novel sensing breakthrough with clear applications in autonomous vehicles and defense.
